data_source: Ruiz-Mateos Brea et al., CC BY 4.0, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17413651
limitations: Measured small-strain bovine hydrogel rheology with saved model fits and held-out predictions; not molecular or cell-force calibration.
Observed standard deviation is between saved replicates, not a predictive confidence interval.
Bootstrap parameter intervals do not supply pointwise predictive intervals.
Use leave_file and leave_concentration separately; extrapolation can be unstable. No models are refit by this viewer.
